name: Go
description: Code intelligence for Go projects using the Go toolchain.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Go files. The language server starts when a Go file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It needs Go on your PATH and installs a pinned gopls version the first time you use it.
